mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 63 degrees and overcast at Verona Community Park, with the moon in its first quarter phase. Tonight will cool down to 58 degrees with no rain in the forecast. For the early risers, the space station will be visible for three minutes starting at 4:09 AM, rising in the south southwest over Belleville and tracking toward the east northeast over Fitchburg and Madison, sitting about halfway up the sky.

The city is actively managing road rehabilitation projects throughout Verona to keep our infrastructure safe. This includes the ongoing Mark Drive reconstruction, which is upgrading water and sewer lines and adding new sidewalks to improve local walkability.

There is a lot going on tomorrow! You can enjoy live music at Concerts in the Park, challenge your friends at Hop Haus Trivia, or visit Insight Wellness for a yoga session. Later this week, look forward to live music at Bailey's Run on Thursday and the Dane County Farmers Market on Saturday.
Regarding the weekly police activity, on Friday at 10:57 p.m., an officer stopped a 29-year-old Verona man who was arrested for an O W I, second offence, along with other traffic violations.

Today's delicious flavor is Double Strawberry. The store is currently closed, but they will open tomorrow at 10:00 AM. If you are looking for tomorrow's treat, they will be serving Chocolate Heath Crunch.
